summary: An interactive website that provides information on rising sea levels within South East Asia. In this website, my team has included about where the sea level is rising within SEA and how much it is rising over time. To make it easier for users, we have made a line chart to show the course of change in sea levels over the years. Other than that, the website also contains a Carbon Footprint calculator to allow users to track how their daily habits can potentially contribute to global warming, which can increase sea levels. The main goal of our website is to increase the awareness of local people on rising sea levels and how it can affect our daily lives. Lastly, our that hope our website can make an impact on the local people to help reduce the risk of rising sea levels.
details: This interactive website shares simple facts about rising sea levels in Southeast Asia. It shows which areas are most affected and how much the water has risen over the years using an easy-to-read line chart. The site also includes a Carbon Footprint Calculator to help visitors see how their daily habits affect global warming and rising oceans. Our main goal is to help local people understand how rising sea levels impact their daily lives and inspire them to take action to lower these risks.
